purpose: Render an explicitly native select when platform-native behavior or form integration is the requirement.
accessibility: Use a visible label or aria-label for the native select.
Native platform keyboard, touch, and form semantics are preserved.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: onChange
api.description: Callback fired when the value or native event changes.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Prevents interaction while preserving the disabled state.
